description: Source code for USB Audio Class 2 (UAC2) implementation in Zephyr OS, including endpoint configuration, control request handling, and data transfer management.

methods.name: uac2_set_ops
methods.description: Sets the operations callbacks and user data for UAC2 device.

methods.name: uac2_send
methods.description: Enqueues data to be sent over a specified terminal endpoint.

methods.name: uac2_update
methods.description: Handles interface alternate setting changes and manages data/feedback endpoints.

methods.name: uac2_sof
methods.description: Handles Start Of Frame events, scheduling data reads and feedback updates.

methods.name: uac2_init
methods.description: Initializes the UAC2 class, verifying registered callbacks.

methods.name: clock_frequencies
methods.description: Retrieves supported clock frequencies for a given clock source entity.
